**1.5.1 colors hotfix.**
## Power readings and hardware support
- Restored power readings on supported Macs running macOS 27 without the background `powermetrics` service or administrator approval. - CHIP power now includes memory and media-engine activity where package energy counters are available. Some workloads show higher wattage because the reading covers more of the chip. - Fixed the GPU frequency chart dropping to zero at idle. - Updated to `macmon` 0.10.0 with revised CPU tier detection on M6 and support for monitoring inside macOS virtual machines.
## Charts
- The power chart stacks component readings so you can see how each contributes to the total. - Made chart series easier to distinguish with pink GPU traces, clearer shading where CPU and GPU usage overlap, and thinner lines for system power, CPU frequency, and temperature. - Improved performance when updating charts and dragging a chart marker. - **1.5.1 hotfix.** Made CHIP and CPU power easier to distinguish at low wattage in both light and dark themes. - **1.5.1 hotfix.** Matched the CPU temperature line to the CPU color used in the power chart.
## Menu bar
- Added a CPU power option. - CPU load now weights each tier by its maximum frequency squared, so efficiency cores contribute less to the overall reading. - Removed the individual CPU tier load and frequency options.
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/homm/StillCore/compare/v1.4.0...v1.5.1

#### Power readings and hardware support
- Restored power readings on supported Macs running macOS 27 without the background `powermetrics` service or administrator approval. - CHIP power now includes memory and media-engine activity where package energy counters are available. Some workloads show higher wattage because the reading covers more of the chip. - Fixed the GPU frequency chart dropping to zero at idle. - Updated to `macmon` 0.10.0 with revised CPU tier detection on M6 and support for monitoring inside macOS virtual machines.
#### Charts
- The power chart stacks component readings so you can see how each contributes to the total. - Made chart series easier to distinguish with pink GPU traces, clearer shading where CPU and GPU usage overlap, and thinner lines for system power, CPU frequency, and temperature. - Improved performance when updating charts and dragging a chart marker.
#### Menu bar
- Added a CPU power option. - CPU load now weights each tier by its maximum frequency squared, so efficiency cores contribute less to the overall reading. - Removed the individual CPU tier load and frequency options.
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/homm/StillCore/compare/v1.4.0...v1.5.0

## Hardware and software compatibility
* Added support for new CPU topologies, including Performance and Super core configurations. * Fixed CPU frequency detection on M5 and newer chips. * Expanded CPU and GPU temperature sensor coverage. * Hardware detection now uses native system APIs where available, avoiding a system_profiler call at startup. * Added an optional background service to restore CPU power updates on macOS 27. Requires administrator approval and stops when StillCore quits. * Fixed the floating window opening behind other apps on macOS Tahoe. * Adjusted energy mode menu positioning on macOS Tahoe and macOS 27.
## Energy mode switching
* Click the battery indicator in the app window to switch between Automatic and Power Save modes for the current power source. * Added guided permission setup for switching modes without repeated password prompts.
## General improvements
* Added Cmd+K to clear chart history while keeping the latest sample. * Made battery tracker setup and service status clearer. * Released StillCore under the MIT License.
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/homm/StillCore/compare/v1.3.0...v1.4.0)

## Menu bar battery item
* Added two battery menu bar modes: percentage and icon. * The icon reflects charging, charged, and Power Save mode states. * Current status is read by the app directly; the helper is only needed for session tracking. * Helper actions are now tucked into a popover, making the integration less intrusive. * System settings can be opened from the indicator in the app window. * Related UI and menu options are hidden on Macs without a battery.
## General improvements
* Updated the app icon. * Added Sparkle-based app updates. * Added a CPU usage setting to show cluster usage weighted by core count. * Fixed memory unit labels to use GB instead of Gb. * Kept minimum window resizing behavior consistent.
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/homm/StillCore/compare/v1.2.0...v1.3.0)

## General improvements
* Click current values to toggle chart series * Relative sample age is shown in chart markers * Attached window is draggable by its header * Battery tracker now shows charging status and current charge more clearly * Battery tracker helper memory usage optimized
## Design update
* Fonts are clearer and better aligned * Chart colors have better contrast in light and dark appearances * Compact update interval control replaces the full-width interval row * Simpler, more recognizable battery indicator * New attach/detach and quit button icons
Special thanks to @valerypopoff and @ilyabirman for the design.
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/homm/StillCore/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0)
